result.note: Tested India's 2025 lead in global ship recycling and the certification gap facing its yards with European owners.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's ship-recycling industry, as reported in June 2026:
items: In 2025, India became the world's top ship-recycling nation, with a 35.4% share of global tonnage.
Indian ship-recycling yards hold the certification that European shipowners look for.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because Indian yards still lack the certification that would make the lead bankable with European owners. India took the top spot in 2025, five years ahead of its target.
questions.source: India became the world's top ship-recycling nation in 2025 with a 35.4% share of global tonnage, five years ahead of target
